description: This PHP source file defines a class LoggerSubscriber that subscribes to exception events in a Symfony-based application. It handles exception events by logging error messages and stack traces.

classes.name: LoggerSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens for kernel exception events and logs error details.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of kernel events this subscriber listens to, specifically the exception event with a high priority.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exception events by retrieving the exception object and logging its message and stack trace.
